+from rich.cells import set_cell_size, chop_cells, cell_len
+
+def test_graphemes():
+    # 💩 is width 2, 🏽 is width 0. Total width 2.
+    text = "💩🏽"
+    print(f"Text: {text}, cell_len: {cell_len(text)}")
+    
+    # Width 2 should return the whole thing
+    print(f"set_cell_size(text, 2): {set_cell_size(text, 2)}")
+    
+    # Width 1 should return a space or empty string, but NOT split the grapheme
+    # In my implementation, it will return " " because current_width (0) < total (1)
+    # and the first grapheme "💩🏽" has width 2, which is > 1.
+    # So it breaks and adds " " * (1 - 0) = " ".
+    print(f"set_cell_size(text, 1): {set_cell_size(text, 1)}")
+
+    # Family emoji: 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 (Man, Woman, Girl, Boy joined by ZWJ)
+    # Each emoji is width 2, ZWJ is width 0.
+    # Total width is 2 * 4 = 8.
+    family = "👨‍👩‍👧‍👦"
+    print(f"Family: {family}, cell_len: {cell_len(family)}")
+    print(f"set_cell_size(family, 8): {set_cell_size(family, 8)}")
+    print(f"set_cell_size(family, 7): {set_cell_size(family, 7)}")
+
+    # Chop cells
+    text_to_chop = "💩🏽💩🏽" # width 2 + 2 = 4
+    print(f"chop_cells(text_to_chop, 2): {chop_cells(text_to_chop, 2)}")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_graphemes()
